author: The Infographics Show
description:
Earning $150,000 to $250,000 a year sounds like you’ve made it. For millions of Americans, it doesn’t feel that way.

High earners can lose a huge chunk of their salary to taxes before mortgage payments, student loans, cars, childcare, groceries, utilities, and retirement contributions even enter the picture. The result? Millions of six-figure professionals are living paycheck to paycheck despite earning far more than the average household. And there’s another problem.
Traditional salaries are taxed very differently from the investments, businesses, and assets that generate much of the wealth of the ultra-rich. So climbing the corporate ladder can leave you earning more, but still struggling to build real wealth.

A six-figure salary can make you look rich. That doesn’t necessarily mean you are.
